author: AfterWorld
name: OnePieceGuess
short: Command-based One Piece image guessing game with team scoring.
description: Timed character, Devil Fruit, and ship guessing rounds with required blurred images, command answers, hints, configurable pools, team scoring, and leaderboards.
install_msg: Load onepieceguess, then use [p]opguess setchannel #channel and [p]opguess toggle true. Run [p]opguess help for setup and commands.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server round settings and entry pools, plus Discord user IDs and win counts. Supports Red data deletion requests for user win data.
